listing.name: Digimon World / psx-recomp-port
listing.summary: Explore Digimon World / psx-recomp-port and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

warnings: The official download is an upstream setup kit, not a ready game. Its own wizard generates and rebuilds the runtime from your disc. Keep the entire prepared project and originals; Portcove does not own its compiler, caches or runtime updates.

steps.title: Finish upstream setup once
steps.instruction: Use the complete official Windows x64 setup ZIP and follow its README-SETUP.txt. Supply your own Digimon World USA SLUS-01032 BIN and matching CUE, choose the CUE, and let upstream validate it. Setup requires Python 3 and offers its own build tools; a retail SCPH-1001 BIOS is optional because upstream can generate OpenBIOS locally. Run the upstream setup yourself and keep its folder/progress if interrupted. Portcove does not run a discovered setup host, compiler or helper.

steps.title: Register the finished game player
steps.instruction: After upstream Generate & rebuild succeeds, select build-release/Digimon_World_Recompiled.exe inside that project, rather than the root setup-forwarding executable or the Play batch file. Set the working directory to the project root. In Arguments, enter --game, game.toml and --launcher on three separate lines, one argument per line, matching the reviewed upstream product handoff. Review and save these launch details, then choose Play explicitly.

steps.title: Keep saves and upstream updates together
steps.instruction: You or upstream update and regenerate this external project. Close the game and preserve the complete prepared folder, including saves/, mods/, game.toml and build-release/, as well as any originals or BIOS stored elsewhere. Ordinary memory-card saves are the long-term progress route; upstream warns that save states and rewind depend on matching mods. Retain the old working copy until progress works after an update. Removing registration preserves every external file; this route does not provide managed Update, Backup or Rollback.
